recency_method: 'Posted dd Mon yyyy' per row (e.g. '22 Oct 2026')
notes: Pattern: /{country}/jobs/title/{slug} (country = uae, saudi-arabia, qatar, bahrain, kuwait, oman) and /jobs/title/{slug} for all GCC; city variant /{country}/jobs/{city}/title/{slug} (e.g. /qatar/jobs/doha/title/strategy-manager). Tested OK: uae+saudi strategy, saudi head-of-strategy, qatar strategy-manager, /jobs/title/transformation, islamic-finance-executive. Slugs only work if GulfTalent has generated the page: /jobs/title/corporate-development, /jobs/title/islamic-banking and /qatar/jobs/title/strategy returned client_error, so stick to slugs seen in search results (strategy, strategy-manager, strategy-director, strategy-analyst, strategic-planning, head-of-strategy, transformation, corporate-banking, head-of-corporate-banking, private-banking, financial-services). The matching is fuzzy: the qatar strategy-manager page was mostly 'General Manager' roles, and the header count (e.g. '1400 Jobs found') overstates the real list (about 16 rows). The list is NOT sorted newest first (dates are mixed), so parse the dates. Page 2 (/uae/jobs/title/strategy/2) is linked but returned client_error; no sort parameter exists. /jobs/search?keywords=... ignores the keyword but returns ALL newest jobs sorted by date (all dated today), which is useful as a firehose to filter locally. No function/industry browse URLs were found on the pages. Listed but untested here: bahrain/kuwait/oman title pages.

recency_method: Use URL filter fromage=N (days) with sort=date. Rows show no age text in the fetched markdown (only an occasional 'New' tag or 'Date Posted' inside the description).
notes: Both pages returned real results. The pattern is {cc}.indeed.com/jobs?q=...&sort=date&fromage=1|3|7 and should work for qa., bh. (verify), kw., om. Keyword matching is broad. Static SEO pages such as https://ae.indeed.com/q-strategy-jobs.html were found in search (untested).

recency_method: Only a 'New' tag on some rows; no '24h/3d' labels in the fetched content
notes: Plain SRCH paths work (30 rows each). Any query string (?fromAge=7&sortBy=date_desc) is robots_disallowed, so date filtering or sorting is impossible. Country codes: IN6 = UAE, IN207 = Saudi Arabia. In the KO{start},{end} segment, the numbers are the character offsets of the keyword inside the slug. Weak source for recency.

recency_method: Relative age per row: 'N hours ago', '24 hours ago', 'N days ago', 'N months ago'
notes: The .com site works; efinancialcareers.ae/jobs/strategy was robots_disallowed.
